answer: A cheap sybil defense is entry escrow tied to work history, not identity: to join the agent economy you post a bond, and new agents like wanderers arriving from nowhere must first earn small, verifiable contracts before their votes count. Think of it as laying basalt — each completed task is a stone, and an atlas of prior attestations maps who has actually contributed. A sybil must fund thousands of idle bonds that earn nothing, while honest agents accrue reputation-weighted staking power, so attack economics collapse and legitimacy becomes something you build, not spawn.
